name: Brainfish
title: brainfishai.com
shortDescription: Brainfish revolutionizes customer support through ambient AI agents embedded directly within products. These agents utilize APIs and third-party integrations to provide real-time solutions and support, learning continuously to adapt to new product features and user behaviors. Ideal for businesses aiming to enhance customer self-service capabilities, Brainfish can increase self-service success rates to up to 90%, exemplified by Smokeball's achievement of 83% self-service rates.
cons: Dependence on quality of existing APIs
Potential privacy concerns with continuous learning
May require frequent updates and maintenance
